messages:
adeel_ml: Quick update: did a micro bring-up for the new 11B (codename: lumen) quantized to int6 on our conversational smoke set. Need a short cost vs quality call.
rachel_eng: Drop the headliners pls (throughput, p95, quality delta).
adeel_ml: Throughput ~2.4x vs lumen-11b-int8 baseline, median token latency -25%, cost per 1M tokens roughly $48 (int6) vs $115 (int8). Quality: E2E QA EM down -1.4% absolute on multi-turn; factuality drift ~-1.9 points on our 3k probe set.
tim_sre: Any instability? p99 spikes or memory pressure?
adeel_ml: No crashes. p99 for >1500 token contexts up ~10%. We saw increased KV-cache miss rate on int6 kernels; added an instrumented trace.
yvonne_prod: Are the regressions concentrated on any intent? billing / legal / search?
adeel_ml: Mostly long-form factual questions and citation-heavy slices. Short replies and intent routing unaffected. Logged examples to /mnt/eval/lumen/int6_fails.log
lee_gtn: GTN preference: hybrid route—int6 default, int8 for payment/legal/search. Can you simulate 80/20 economics?
adeel_ml: 80% int6 + 20% int8 gives ~2.1x cost savings and weighted EM loss ~0.5%. 95/5 gives ~2.6x savings but EM ~1.1%.
deploy-bot: canary-deploy: lumen-int6 @ 1.5% traffic created. Monitoring: latency, kvcache-miss-rate, factuality-score.
tim_sre: Add circuit-breaker: rollback if factuality drops >1.5 or p95 latency increases >30% for 30m. Also enable heap alerts for int6 kernels.
yvonne_prod: OK to proceed with 1.5% canary + UX QA on a short set. Tagging @lee_gtn for ramp decision after 24h.
adeel_ml: Will push eval bundle and examples, iterate after 24h metrics. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
